summary: Full-matrix Phase-2 entitlement gating validation (backend + desktop + mobile + admin + regression). Backend pytest: 36/36 PASS covering (a) 10 gated endpoints returning 402 with detail.code=upgrade_required and exact min_plan under X-Plan-Preview: simple_start, (b) same 10 endpoints NOT returning 402 under X-Plan-Preview: advanced, (c) same 10 endpoints NOT returning 402 in shadow mode (no header), (d) GET /api/companies/{cid}/entitlements quotas match PLAN_QUOTAS for assistant/simple_start/bookkeeper previews, (e) GET /api/admin/entitlements/events returns 200 with required keys for admin / 403 for pro / 422 for days=0. Frontend: desktop 1920x1080 pro@axiom.ai + simple_start preview → sidebar accounting accordion shows all 5 lock glyphs (nav-lock-month_close/bookkeeper_review/outlook/inventory/sales_tax); clicking locked Month Close does NOT navigate and opens upgrade-modal containing 'AI Month-End Close', upgrade-modal-close closes it; advanced preview → 0 locks and Month Close navigates to /accounting/month-close; real preview → 0 locks (shadow). Mobile 390x844 /owner + simple_start → mobile-nav-lock-checkins/chat visible, tapping mobile-nav-chat opens upgrade-modal 'AI Review Chat', tapping mobile-nav-check-in opens upgrade-modal 'AI Proactive Check-Ins' and does NOT navigate to /checkin; bookkeeper preview → 0 mobile locks and check-in tab navigates to /checkin. Admin: nav-admin-entitlements link on /admin navigates to /admin/entitlements; page renders admin-entitlements-page, admin-entitlements-mode banner starts with 'Shadow mode', 4 stat cards (WOULD-BLOCK/COMPANIES/PREVIEW-ENFORCED/ALL EVENTS = 0/0/14/14), By-feature + By-plan breakdowns, 10 admin-entitlements-row-* rows with Bright Beans Coffee Co. preview-generated events; admin-entitlements-days selector changes to 7 (verified input_value) and reloads; refresh button works. Regression (pro, NO preview): sidebar Month Close navigates to /accounting/month-close; mobile Check-in navigates to /checkin; mobile Chat tap does NOT open upgrade-modal (opens chat sheet as expected).
critical_code_review_comments: Login endpoint response key is 'token' (not 'access_token'); fine but worth documenting for test author consistency across new test files.
